demoNotice.text: Indesk is a demo. Do not upload private or sensitive files.

hero.eyebrow: A team of AI agents that shows its work
hero.title: Answers from your files, with proof.
hero.lede: Upload a spreadsheet, a photo of a chart or a PDF. Five animal agents read, calculate and search, and a critic checks every claim before you see the report.

film.label: Demo of an Indesk run
film.description: A 10-second loop: files arrive, a question is asked, five animal agents work, and a verified report appears.
film.question: Which stations grew fastest since 2019?

team.title: Meet the team
team.sub: Each agent has one job, and you can open its work at any time.

owl.name: Owl
owl.desc: Reads your question, picks a plan and merges the results.
owl.see: The plan, and how your question was classified.

chameleon.name: Chameleon
chameleon.desc: Reads photos, charts and scanned pages.
chameleon.see: The photo with every detected bar and the text it read.

beaver.name: Beaver
beaver.desc: Runs real calculations on your tables in a safe sandbox.
beaver.see: The exact code and the table it produced.

hound.name: Hound
hound.desc: Sniffs out the right passages in long PDFs.
hound.see: Matched passages with page numbers and scores.

cat.name: Cat
cat.desc: Checks every claim against the evidence, and flags the weak ones.
cat.see: Each claim with its evidence and a verdict.

modes.title: Three ways to work with your files
modes.sub: Tables are computed over every row, never pasted into a chat. Each answer shows where it came from.

ask.title: Ask a question
ask.body: Ask in your own words. The team computes, reads and checks, then hands you a cited report.
ask.example: Example: Which stations grew fastest since 2019?

check.title: Check a document
check.body: Give us a report and the data behind it. We test every claim and show which ones do not hold.
check.example: Example: 4 of 6 claims hold, 1 does not match

compare.title: Compare
compare.body: Two months, two versions, two sources. We show what changed and prove it.

publish.title: Data journalists
publish.text: Check a city’s open data against an official PDF before publishing.

paper.title: Students and researchers
paper.text: Ask one question across a paper’s tables and figures, with page references.

weekly.title: Small-team analysts
weekly.text: Turn last month’s export and a screenshot into a cited summary for the weekly meeting.

board.title: Nonprofit staff
board.text: Read a funder’s PDF report and a donations sheet together to answer a board question.

enforce.title: How the limits are enforced
items: The server counts runs per account, not the browser.
Files are checked for type, size and rows before any AI runs.
Sign-ups are limited per hour, which protects the free runs.
A daily budget cap stops any single day from costing too much.
enforce.demoNote: These are the design rules. This demo page does not enforce them.
